evidence: Has the Utils/log/libs label and directly modifies cryptographic context wiring and lifecycle management in src/crypto/ and src/common/ecc_init.
rationale: Hardware-accelerated SHA256 compression is integrated into libsecp256k1 contexts, speeding up cryptographic signing operations. Description benchmarks show ECDSA signing improves by ~13–15% and Schnorr signing by ~3–7% on CPUs with SHA extensions (e.g., x86 SHA-NI and ARMv8).
